content: मोहः [मुह् घञ्] .²1 Loss of consciousness, fainting, a swoon, insensibility; मोहेनान्तर्वरतनुरियं लक्ष्यते मुच्यमाना <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>; मोहादभूत् कष्टतरः प्रबोधः <ls>R. 14. 56</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 73</ls>; कतिचन पेतुरुपेत्य मोहमुद्राम् <ls>Śiva B. 28. 88</ls>. .²2 Perplexity, delusion, embarrassment, confusion; यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव <ls>Bg. 4. 35</ls>. .²3 Folly, ignorance, infatuation; तितीर्षुर्दुस्तरं मोहादुडुपेनास्मि सागरम् <ls>R. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 25</ls>. .²4 Error, mistake. .²5 Wonder, astonishment. .²6 Affliction, pain. .²7 A magical art employed to confound an enemy. .²8 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Delusion of mind which prevents one from discerning the truth (makes one believe in the reality of worldly objects and to be addicted to the gratification of sensual pleasures); महामोहं च मोहं च तमश्चाज्ञानवृत्तयः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 12. 2</ls>. .²9 Illusion of attachment or love; स्वगृहोद्यानगतेऽपि स्निग्धैः पापं विशङ्क्यते मोहात् <ls>Pt. 2. 171</ls>.
